metadata.description: Scan packaged commodity labels and check mandatory declarations against the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India.

meta.title: Digi-Pramaan
meta.description: Check packaged commodity labels against the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. A compliance system for the Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India.

hero.title: Check a label against the Rules in seconds, not hours
hero.body: Digi-Pramaan reads the mandatory declarations off a packaged commodity, checks each one against the Rules, and produces a citable compliance record. Built for the officers who do this work in the field.
hero.trustLine: A service of the Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

services.heading: Three ways a product reaches the system
services.body: Every route produces the same compliance record, so a case is handled the same way however it arrived.

inspection.title: Field inspection
inspection.body: An officer photographs the front, back and principal display panel. Each image is quality-checked before it costs anything to process.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce listing
ecommerce.body: Paste a product listing URL, or a whole category page, and the system pulls the listing images through the same checks. No physical pack needed.

grievance.title: Citizen report
grievance.body: A shopper photographs a label that looks wrong. The report enters an officer's queue with no account and no form-filling.

pipeline.heading: How a scan becomes a compliance record
pipeline.body: Seven stages, each one visible while it runs. A failed stage can be retried on its own rather than restarting the scan.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: Front, back and principal display panel.

quality.title: Quality gate
quality.body: Blur, skew, curvature and text visibility, per image.

ocr.title: Text extraction
ocr.body: Primary OCR pass across all three images.

fallback.title: Second opinion
fallback.body: Low-confidence fields re-read by a second engine.

structuring.title: Structuring
structuring.body: Readings reconciled into one record, each field traced to its image.

rules.title: Rule engine
rules.body: Rules 6, 7 and 8 evaluated against the structured record.

score.title: Compliance record
score.body: Violations cited by rule, ready for an officer to verify.

taxonomy.heading: What we check for
taxonomy.body: Every finding is reported as one of ten categories, each tied to the rule it comes from. A report cites the rule, not a generic verdict.
taxonomy.provenanceBody: The same ten categories appear on the verification screen, the compliance record, the analytics breakdown and the manufacturer scorecard. An enforcement action has to survive scrutiny, so the language cannot drift between the screen an officer saw and the report they filed.

citizens.heading: Seen a label that looks wrong?
citizens.body: If a price is missing, a manufacturer is not named, or the text is too small to read, you can report it. No account, no sign-in, and your contact details are optional.

submit.title: Photograph it
submit.body: One photo of the label is all that is required.

review.title: An officer reviews it
review.body: Your report joins the same queue as an officer's own scan.

outcome.title: Track it
outcome.body: You get a reference number to check the status later.

scan.description: Photograph the front, back and principal display panel of the product. Each image is checked for quality before it counts as captured.

manufacturers.description: Compliance history grouped by manufacturer, so repeat patterns are visible across products rather than one scan at a time.
manufacturers.errorBody: Something went wrong loading manufacturer data. Try again.
manufacturers.exactMatchNote: Manufacturer names are matched exactly. Two spellings of the same company appear as two manufacturers here, which can undercount a repeat offender.

formats.hint: Choose one or both. The problem statement asks for PDF and an editable format, so both are genuinely available here.
formats.hint_PDF: Fixed layout, suitable for printing and filing.
formats.hint_DOCX: Editable in Word, LibreOffice or Google Docs.

largeScope.body: This scope covers {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, above the {threshold}-record threshold where reports get long. Generating will still work, it will just take longer and produce a long document.

blocked.zeroRecordsBody: This scope matches no records, so there is nothing to put in a report. Widen the filters or choose a different scope, then try again.

generationError.title: Could not generate the report

preview.heading: Preview
preview.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

preview.perRecordVerifierNote: This report covers work by several officers. Each record below names its own verifying officer.

preview.untaggedTitle: This PDF is not tagged for accessibility
preview.untaggedBody: The generated PDF has no structure tags, so a screen reader cannot navigate its headings and tables. The Word version and this on-screen preview are both fully readable. Flagged rather than hidden, per WCAG 1.3.1.

security.heading: Password

security.unavailableBody: This build has no live authentication directory, so a password cannot actually be changed. The control is shown disabled rather than reporting a success that did not happen.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.body: Choose where you are notified about scans, verifications and enforcement actions.
notifications.channelsNote: Email and SMS are not wired up in this build, so both are shown disabled rather than offering a switch that does nothing.

grievance.heading: Report a packaging concern
grievance.intro: If a product label looks wrong to you, tell us. Photograph the label and send it in. An enforcement officer will check it against the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
grievance.noAccountNote: No account and no login. A photo is all we need.
grievance.description: Report a product label that may not meet Legal Metrology packaging rules. No account needed.

form.heading: Send a report
form.photoHelp: Get the whole label in frame if you can. This is the only thing we need from you.
form.photoEmpty: Add a photo of the label
form.photoFormatHint: JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB
form.cameraDenied: We could not open the camera. You can choose a photo from your device instead.
form.photoRequiredBody: Attach a photo of the label and we can look into it. Nothing else is required.
form.contextHeading: Anything else you can tell us
form.contextHelp: All of this is optional. A report with just a photo is complete, and is treated exactly the same as one with every field filled in.
form.noteHint: Anything you noticed that the choices above do not cover.
form.shopHint: Helps an officer find the same product on a shelf.
form.contactHint: Only so we can follow up if we need to. We will not publish it.
form.submitErrorTitle: We could not send your report
form.submitErrorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Your photo and everything you typed are still here, so you can try again without redoing any of it.

concerns.textTooSmall: Text is too small to read

quality.blurryBody: You can send it as it is and we will still look at it. A sharper photo just makes the label easier to read.
quality.darkBody: You can send it as it is and we will still look at it. More light on the label would make it easier to read.

confirmation.heading: Report received
confirmation.body: Thank you. Your report has been logged and will be reviewed.
confirmation.referenceHelp: Save this or take a screenshot. You will need it to check your report later.
confirmation.next1: Your photo goes through the same label-reading process as one taken by an enforcement officer.
confirmation.next2: An officer reviews what was found and decides whether the label meets the rules.
confirmation.next3: You can check the progress of your report at any time using the reference above.
confirmation.contactNote: You gave us contact details, so we may get in touch if we need to ask you anything.

lookup.heading: Check a report

lookup.label: Reference
lookup.notFoundBody: We could not find a report with that reference. Please check it and try again.

explain.Received: Your report has been logged and is waiting to be looked at.
explain.Under Review: An officer is working on your report now.
explain.Resolved: An officer has finished reviewing your report.
